requirements.statement: normalize_name(value) trims surrounding whitespace and lowercases the result.

findings.title: Internal helper renamed from _normalize to _canonicalize; public behavior unchanged

source_anchors.excerpt: normalize_name(value) trims surrounding whitespace and lowercases the result.

findings.rationale: The change renames the private helper _normalize to _canonicalize and updates the single call site in normalize_name. The public function signature, its behavior (value.strip().lower()), and its name are all unchanged. REQ-TRIAGE-003 mandates only the behavior of the public normalize_name function, which is fully satisfied: the implementation calls _canonicalize, which executes value.strip().lower(). The test exercises the public contract boundary (leading/trailing whitespace trimming and lowercasing) and passes. Change evidence (change.patch) confirms this is a pure internal rename with no behavioral delta. DR-006 applies: behavioral_contract_changed=false, tests_green=true, no_requirement_drift=true. Finding type HARMLESS_REFACTOR is the most specific applicable type per the domain_rules finding_type_selection policy.
